# Output Rules

## Target File
ALL output goes to: `QA-AUDIT-REPORT.md`
Do NOT put audit results in chat only — they must be in the file.

## Status Markers
| Marker | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ✅ | Fully covered / Found / Consistent |
| 🟡 | Partially covered / Incomplete |
| 🔴 | Not covered / Missing / Broken |
| ⚠️ | Inconsistency found |
| N/A | Meta-instruction section (skip) |

## Table Rules
- Each task (T1-T6) gets its own H2 section in the report
- Each table has a summary row at the bottom with counts
- Max 1 line per entry — use Notes column for context
- No standalone paragraphs between tables

## File References
- Use just the filename: `ungasis-prompt-library.md`
- Not the full path: ~~`modules/libraries/ungasis-prompt-library.md`~~
- Reference sections as: `§13`, `§14`, etc.

## Report Header Template
```markdown
# 🏰 UNGASIS OS v3.0 — QA Audit Report

**Auditor:** Cline + DeepSeek V4 Flash | **Date:** [auto] | **Files in Repo:** [count]

---
```
